first.rationale: Current context shows two simultaneous pressures: competitor aggressive pricing targeting price-sensitive SMB (directly addressed by memory_73's proven promotional pricing lift) and declining activation/onboarding metrics (4-6% QoQ drops). We need to verify memory_73 (promotional pricing effectiveness) and memory_86 (onboarding simplification durability) to confirm which lever is most reliable. Promotional pricing directly counters the competitive threat in our most price-elastic segment and has documented revenue and acquisition lift without retention harm. This addresses the immediate revenue hemorrhage while we can sequence activation improvements in follow-up experiments. Verifying memory_86 ensures onboarding simplification gains are still durable; if they've eroded, we have a secondary action. Primary objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue—promotional pricing preserves customer quality (SMB focus, no margin-destructive discounting on enterprise) while defending share. Standard experiment scale appropriate for week-long window and single-slot constraint.

final.rationale: Archive verification revealed critical insight: memory_73's promotional pricing drives +31% signup and +18% qualified revenue but suffers -12% 30-day retention and does not survive renewal. This directly violates the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. The acquired cohort is acquisition-focused debt, not durable revenue. Memory_86 shows onboarding simplification delivers +13% completion, -2.1 days time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention—a sustainable triple win. Given current 4-6% QoQ drops in activation and onboarding completion, and the proven durability of simplification, this is the highest-confidence lever for addressing root activation decline while preserving retention and renewal health. Competitor pricing pressure is real but promotional pricing is a trap for a company optimizing long-term value. Simplified onboarding also improves relative product stickiness against competitive entry by getting users to value faster. This preserves uncertainty about other vectors (referral, activation messaging) for future slots.
